en-IN.longDescription: Connect once, forget forever. Loqin PC is a lightweight Windows system tray application designed to automatically authenticate and keep you connected to VIT hostel Wi-Fi. Made for and by VITians.
en-IN.name: Loqin
en-IN.releaseNotes:
- On-Demand Speed Graph: Graph engine and charting load only when opened.
- Smarter Dialog Cleanup: Frees memory and UI resources when closed.
- Lean Account Tools: Account history and parser dependencies load on demand.
- Quiet Wi-Fi Picker: Background network scanning pauses while closed.
- Dynamic Speed Updates: Traffic is sampled on demand for tray/graph updates.
- Reactive Network Monitoring: Uses native OS network events with fallback polling.
